# Extract numeric away team scores from the "away team score" column
# The scores are in format like "9.11 (65)" where the number in parentheses is the total points
# We need to extract the numeric total points (the part inside parentheses)
df['away_score_numeric'] = df['away team score'].str.extract(r'\((\d+)\)').astype(int)

# Count total number of away teams (each row corresponds to one away team)
total_away_teams = df.shape[0]

# Count number of away teams with score > 10
away_teams_gt_10 = (df['away_score_numeric'] > 10).sum()

# Check if exactly 1/3 of away teams had score > 10
# Since we're dealing with integer counts, we need to check if away_teams_gt_10 equals total_away_teams/3
# But total_away_teams/3 might not be integer, so we need to check the proportion
answer = away_teams_gt_10 == total_away_teams / 3
~~~
